# Roy Quick Real Estate

> Roy Quick is a Realtor® with LUXRE Realty, Inc. (CA DRE #02417080) based at 222 Avenida Del Mar, San Clemente, CA 92672. He helps homeowners in San Clemente, Dana Point, Capistrano Beach, San Juan Capistrano and the rest of South Orange County sell or lease their homes, works with real estate investors, and specializes in relisting homes that did not sell the first time. Phone/text 980-416-6412, email roy@roysoldquick.com.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://roysoldquick.com/): listings, expired-listing help, about Roy, LUXRE Realty, contact
- [Market Updates](https://roysoldquick.com/market-updates/): weekly South OC housing market reports with cited sources

## Recent market updates
- [Selling in December? Property Taxes, the Dec. 10 Deadline and Prop 19 for San Clemente and Dana Point Owners (December 2026)](https://roysoldquick.com/market-updates/selling-in-december-san-clemente-dana-point-property-taxes-december-2026/): Orange County's first property tax installment is due Dec. 10. Roy Quick runs the proration and Prop 19 math for San Clemente and Dana Point sellers.
- [Rates Jumped Back to 7.28%: What San Clemente and Dana Point Sellers Can Do Now (November 2026)](https://roysoldquick.com/market-updates/rates-jump-san-clemente-dana-point-sellers-november-2026/): Mortgage rates jumped to 7.28%, adding about $165 a month on a San Clemente median home. Roy Quick runs the price-cut vs. rate-buydown math for sellers.
- [El Niño Winter in San Clemente and Dana Point: What Homeowners and Sellers Should Know (November 2026)](https://roysoldquick.com/market-updates/el-nino-winter-san-clemente-dana-point-sellers-november-2026/): NOAA gives SoCal a 60-70% chance of a wetter-than-normal winter. Roy Quick on what El Niño means for San Clemente, Dana Point and Capistrano Beach sellers.
- [Home Didn't Sell? Relisting in San Clemente and Dana Point: November 2026](https://roysoldquick.com/market-updates/relist-san-clemente-dana-point-home-november-2026/): 443 Orange County listings were pulled in one week, twice the norm. Roy Quick explains how San Clemente and Dana Point sellers can relist smarter for spring.
- [Sell or Lease Your San Clemente Home? November 2026 Market Update](https://roysoldquick.com/market-updates/sell-or-lease-san-clemente-home-november-2026/): San Clemente 3-bedroom rentals average about $6,500 a month while rates dip to 7.24%. Roy Quick runs the sell-or-lease math for South OC homeowners, plus Capistrano Beach and Norte Fire updates.
- [San Clemente Housing Market Update: October 2026](https://roysoldquick.com/market-updates/san-clemente-housing-market-update-october-2026/): San Clemente home prices rose about 4% year over year while inventory tightened, Dana Point jumped 16.6%, and rates sit near 7.3%. Roy Quick breaks down what it means for South OC sellers, landlords and investors.
